# NSE India 1-Minute OHLCV Historical Market Data

> Public, date-partitioned historical one-minute candle data for National Stock Exchange of India instruments and indices.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/olo-labs/olo-testdata-nse-min-candle

## Key facts

- Data paths: `Minute/NSE` for `.NSE` instruments and `Minute/NSE_IDX` for `.NSE_IDX` indices.
- Archive format: one ZIP per date, named `DDMMYYYY.zip`, containing one CSV.
- Columns: `Ticker, Date, Time, Open, High, Low, Close, Volume, Open Interest`.
- Verified archive coverage at documentation time: 2024-11-25 through 2026-08-03.
- There are 419 archives in each data path.
- Dates are day-first. CSV dates use `DD/MM/YYYY`; archive dates use `DDMMYYYY`.
- The files do not declare timezone or corporate-action adjustment status.
- The dataset contains OHLCV market data, not deliverable quantity or delivery percentage.
- License file: Apache License 2.0. Users must independently assess upstream market-data obligations.
